get.summary: GET /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/events — SSE stream of agent-specific events
get.description:
Streams real-time events for a specific agent including:
- Agent lifecycle events (state changes)
- Agent messages (sent/received)
- Lock events (acquired/released)
- DAG node events (complete/failed/warned/escalated)

The stream filters the global activity feed to only include events
relevant to the specified agent_id.

Query parameters:
- `after_sequence`: Replay events after this sequence number (for resumption)

SECURITY: Rejects with 503 when the connection cap is reached.

parameters.name: after_sequence
parameters.description: Replay events after this sequence number

AgentExitCodeResponse.description: Response for agent exit code endpoint.

exit_code.description: `null` if still running, `0` for normal exit, non-zero for error.

config_options.description:
Configuration options reported by the agent (includes modes like auto-approval, plan mode).
`None` if agent hasn't reported any config options yet.

continuation_count.description: Number of automatic prompt continuations performed (when auto-continue is enabled).

lifecycle_state.description: Detailed lifecycle state from the unified state machine

session_id.description: ACP session ID for session persistence and recovery.

session_title.description: Session title reported by the agent via `SessionUpdate::SessionInfoUpdate`.

state_changed_at.description: When the lifecycle state last changed.

stop_reason.description:
Stop reason from the most recent prompt response (e.g., EndTurn, MaxTokens,
Refusal, Cancelled). `None` if no prompt has completed yet.

AgentLastActivityResponse.description: Response for agent last structured activity age endpoint.

last_activity_age_secs.description: Seconds since the agent's last structured activity event.

AuditQuery.description: Query parameters for audit log endpoint.

id.description:
Optional workspace ID (auto-generated snowflake ID if omitted).
Must be a valid snowflake format (e.g., "ws_1727568000000_001_0001") if provided.

ElicitationInfo.description: Elicitation info (agent request for user input).

ExecuteCommandRequest.description: Request to execute a slash command on an agent.

ExecuteCommandResponse.description: Response from executing a slash command.

output.description: Raw output text from the agent.

ListProfilesWithStatusResponse.description: Response for listing profiles with status

LockInfo.description: Response item for a single active file lock.

MessageResponse.description:
Response DTO for messages with formatted string IDs.

The raw `user_data_db::Message` carries i64 snowflake IDs which exceed
JavaScript's 2^53 safe-integer range when serialized as JSON numbers,
causing precision loss in the desktop UI. Format them as typed strings
like every other response DTO.

id.description: Optional workspace ID (auto-generated snowflake ID if omitted).

PlanInfo.description: Execution plan info for an agent.

ProfileResponse.description: Response for a single agent profile

ProfileWithStatusResponse.description: Response for a profile with installation status

images.description: Optional image attachments sent as base64 ACP content blocks.

interrupt.description:
Whether to insert this message at the next safe point (after thinking/tool completion)
rather than waiting in FIFO queue. Default: false.

sender_agent_id.description: Optional sender identity for agent-to-agent UI rendering.

wait_for_stream.description:
Server-side dispatchers can execute immediately; chat transports wait
for their paired SSE stream to subscribe first.

RecentQuery.description: Query parameters for recent events endpoint

RegisterProfileRequest.description: Request to register a new agent profile

decision.description: One of: allow_once, allow_always, reject_once, reject_always.

form_data.description: Optional form data for elicitation requests.

RespondToElicitationRequest.description: Request body for responding to an elicitation.

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation to append the external message to before delivery.

correlation_id.description:
Correlation ID for linking a response back to its original request.
Required when `message_type = "response"`. Take from the received
request's `_meta.correlation_id`. Ignored for request/broadcast.

force_new_session.description: Force spawn a new agent session instead of reusing an existing one.

from.description:
Optional sender identifier. Defaults to "api" if not provided.
Workflows can set this to identify themselves in message history.

message_type.description:
Optional message type: "request", "response", or "broadcast".
Defaults to "request" if not provided.

sender_agent_name.description: Optional display name for UI rendering.

target_agent_command.description:
Target agent command for agent-to-agent routing (e.g., "claude", "codex").
When present, the backend will route to an agent with this command bound to the same chat.

SpawnAgentRequest.description: Request body for spawning a new agent.

command.description:
Agent profile name from the profile registry (e.g., "claude-code", "general-purpose").
The backend will look up the profile and use its configured command to start the agent.
For backward compatibility, if the profile is not found, this is treated as a raw command.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the agent process.

instruction.description: Optional instruction/prompt to send to the agent after startup.

inherit_context.description: Whether to inherit context from the parent agent

reason.description: Reason for spawning a new session

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID for the new agent (defaults to parent's workspace)

signal.description: POSIX signal name without the SIG prefix, e.g. `INT`, `TERM`, `KILL`.

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds (from first_seen to last_updated).

input_preview.description: Preview of tool arguments (JSON, truncated to 200 chars).

kind.description: Tool category (read, edit, delete, execute, search, think, fetch, etc.).

locations.description: File paths affected (each as "path:line" or just "path").

output_preview.description: Preview of tool results (JSON, truncated to 200 chars).

started_at.description: When the tool call was first seen (relative, e.g. "5s ago").
